title: Managed Database: invoice due days
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database invoice due days is specified by contracted tier. Calendar days after invoice issue for payment maturity; integer. Calendar days after invoice maturity before collection suspension; integer.

| Contracted tier | Invoice due days | Suspension grace days |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 30 | 15 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 30 | 15 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 30 | 15 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 30 | 15 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 30 | 15 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 30 | 15 |

## Tier comparison
For invoice due days, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 30.
